authority.approved_by: Codex GPUWM validation task under the user's explicit finish-and-validate mandate
basis: GPUWM's official-WRF per-process oracle gates establish formula-level NSSL-2 fidelity before any production trajectory is admitted
gpuwm.verify.nest_gates.REFL_10CM_FSS_FAMILY supplies the repository's preregistered 20/30/40 dBZ event thresholds and 5 km neighborhood family
No defensible repository authority exists for fixed 12-hour NSSL mass, number, volume, precipitation, or hail CPU-vs-GPU difference tolerances; those metrics remain mandatory report-only diagnostics
authority.ratification_scope: The structural and numerical-health gates are strict. Scientific acceptance applies only to nondegenerate composite-reflectivity FSS rows under the frozen thresholds; all continuous native-state, precipitation, hail, and inventory metrics remain report-only.

health.nonnegative_epsilon_basis: Matches tools/run_real74_nssl2_500m.py on-disk acceptance; it is a numerical-health allowance, not a scientific-difference tolerance.

composite_reflectivity.numeric_basis: Pre-run ratification of gpuwm.verify.nest_gates.REFL_10CM_FSS_FAMILY for storm-morphology validation of this matched NSSL-2 experiment.

gridscale_precipitation.numeric_basis: Frozen diagnostic event levels only; no unsupported acceptance minimum is asserted.

hail_accumulation.numeric_basis: Frozen diagnostic event levels only; no unsupported acceptance minimum is asserted.

surface_metric_convention.fss_formula: 1 - sum((Fc-Fr)^2) / sum(Fc^2+Fr^2), edge-extended square neighborhood; a row is held when either event coverage is below the floor
